coverage_note: 20 of 26 eligible businesses surfaced by my own searches were already listed (77%, above the 70% bar). The FAIL rests on excluded types still in the list (Trinity Rehab, Hackensack Meridian PT, Kessler, Computer Troubleshooters, LenoyMED) plus several data-quality defects. Not counted as eligible: service-area pages for out-of-town MSPs (Lifeline, BMT, Rekall, KRS), and chains/banks/hospital departments the mapper correctly excluded.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Cylex, BestProsInTown, Birdeye and Kessler pages returned 403 or blocked fetching, so entries sourced only to those aggregators (Friendly Computers, Star Accounting, Edison Technologies, Xonyx, BlueWater Marketing, Business Machine-type listings) could not be re-read directly.

hronich.com, arch2inc.com, rnrsoftware.com, chipcomsystems.com and selfimagesolutions.com would not load from this environment (403/failure/DNS), so those entries are marked 'could not open' or 'not found' rather than confirmed.

The 'Metuchen small businesses within 1 mile' PDF (RPA/Middlesex Greenway appendix) appeared in results for Platinum Property Management and Edison Technologies but I did not open it, so those addresses rest on search snippets.
Directory-only entries with no street address in the source (several dentists, therapists and psychologists) could not be independently placed in Metuchen; they are neither confirmed nor refuted.
No OSM/registry cross-check: Metuchen publishes no business licence list, so coverage is a lower bound.
